C1_C16.C1: Scope includes all sessions capable of accessing the BuildKit control plane.
C1_C16.C11: Security projection must be versioned separately from raw diagnostics.
C1_C16.C12:
Synthetic qualification may represent authorized, unauthorized, unknown,
and incomplete client-census states.
It must not claim actual live authorization.
C1_C16.C13: Candidate construction may proceed while production remains BLOCKED.
C1_C16.C14: No production effectivity from this decision.
C1_C16.C15:
Unresolved live/historical clients remain unresolved.
No cleanup or exoneration authority.
C1_C16.C16: Operational remediation requires separate explicit Human-PI authority.
C1_C16.C2:
Historical unknown execs remain ORIGIN_NOT_ESTABLISHED.
No retrospective authorization.
No automatic malicious classification.
C1_C16.C3:
Every current active control-capable session must be independently established
as AUTHORIZED or independently established UNABLE_TO_ACCESS_CONTROL_PLANE.
C1_C16.C4: An unattributed active session is UNKNOWN, not AUTHORIZED.
C1_C16.C5:
Unknown control-capable sessions => production BLOCK.
Incomplete client census => production BLOCK.
Unverifiable access boundary => production BLOCK.
C1_C16.C6:
Admissible evidence includes authenticated host launch/process provenance,
correlated Docker Engine exec metadata, independently verified socket-access
restrictions, verified container process/endpoint relationships, or another
separately reviewed equivalent source.
C1_C16.C7:
Process name, buildctl binary, timestamps, ExecID, incomplete log absence,
or matching network configuration ALONE are insufficient.
C1_C16.C8:
Completeness requires accounting for every observed active control-capable
session and verifying the control-plane access boundary.
Unobserved/unverifiable surfaces remain disclosed and block production.
C1_C16.C9:
Freshly validate before durable claim.
Independently validate again before provider build.

canonical_serialization.byte_sha256: SHA256 exact serialized bytes; reserialization must equal supplied bytes

classification_order: Unattributed or inadmissible evidence is UNKNOWN
Independently established inaccessible sessions are UNABLE_TO_ACCESS_CONTROL_PLANE
Independently established permitted principal and correlated access is AUTHORIZED
Any UNKNOWN, incomplete census or unverifiable boundary blocks
completeness: Exact observed session set, connected socket/process correlation and all independently accepted access surfaces; unobserved surfaces or incomplete coverage block
correlation: Every session ID occurs exactly once in observed census and exactly once in independently authenticated evidence; process/session/endpoint IDs, source hashes and stage acquisition agree
failure: BLOCK before claim / one failure terminal if changed after claim; no build, no retry
historical_clients: ORIGIN_NOT_ESTABLISHED; no retrospective authorization, exoneration or malicious classification
production_evidence_origin: Fixed separately reviewed installed observer source, exact SHA bound by new independently accepted effectivity and installation authority; no caller data or authorized Boolean
production_live_observer: Not installed or accepted; absent observer/authenticated provenance is BLOCKED
scope: Every active session capable of accessing BuildKit control plane, including host, Engine exec/attach, container processes, Unix/TCP endpoints and unobserved access surfaces
synthetic: Only candidate-owned exact path constructor reads synthetic evidence, explicitly labeled synthetic; never real authorization
